ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the rising-edge timing for the ctrl register and is forwarded to the memory instance. It times synchronous updates of ctrl.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) in ctrl_engine_sync and port map clk_i => clk_i

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Asserts reset logic in the ctrl process and is forwarded to the memory instance. It clears ctrl fields when '0'.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... in ctrl_engine_sync and port map rstn_i => rstn_i

ports.name: host_req_i
ports.functionality: Supplies host request fields used to drive bus_req_o, to decide state transitions, and to provide addresses/data to the cache outputs. It is the primary external request input.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i; various if conditions and default assignments in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: host_req_i.addr
ports.functionality: Provides the 32-bit address used for cache lookup and for forming bus and cache addresses. It seeds ctrl_nxt.tag/idx slices and the default cache_o.addr.
role: slices to next-state tag and index
ports.evidence: cache_o.addr <= host_req_i.addr; ctrl_nxt.tag/idx <= host_req_i.addr(...) in S_LOOKUP

ports.name: host_req_i.data
ports.functionality: Carries host-provided write data into cache_o.data by default; used when servicing writes or passing write data toward the memory interface.
ports.evidence: cache_o.data <= host_req_i.data in ctrl_engine_comb default

ports.name: host_req_i.ben
ports.functionality: Provides byte-enable bits used to set cache_o.we when a cache line is hit and a write is requested, gating partial-word writes.
ports.evidence: cache_o.we <= host_req_i.ben inside S_LOOKUP when cache hit and write path

ports.name: host_req_i.stb
ports.functionality: Signals the presence of a host request and contributes to setting the buffered request flag. It gates state transitions from IDLE into lookup/download paths.
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb; conditions in S_IDLE use host_req_i.stb

ports.name: host_req_i.rw
ports.functionality: Selects read vs write behavior through conditional branches: it gates whether responses are served from cache or whether the bus is used for writes/downloads.
role: gates state transitions and write paths
ports.evidence: if (host_req_i.rw = '0') ... used in S_LOOKUP and S_DOWNLOAD_REQ branches

ports.name: host_req_i.src
ports.functionality: Carries the request source bit as part of the host_req_i aggregate and is forwarded into bus_req_o by the default aggregate copy; not used elsewhere in this source.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i in ctrl_engine_comb (aggregate copy)

ports.name: host_req_i.priv
ports.functionality: Provides privilege bit as part of host_req_i; it is carried into bus_req_o by the aggregate copy but not otherwise examined here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i (aggregate copy) in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: host_req_i.debug
ports.functionality: Used in IDLE decision to force a direct (uncached) request path by setting buf_dir when asserted; it influences whether bus accesses bypass the cache.
ports.evidence: if ... (host_req_i.amo = '1') or (host_req_i.debug = '1') then ctrl_nxt.buf_dir <= '1' in S_IDLE

ports.name: host_req_i.amo
ports.functionality: Indicates atomic operations and is used with other fields to set buf_dir in IDLE, forcing direct bus operation rather than cache servicing.
ports.evidence: IDLE branch checks host_req_i.amo to set ctrl_nxt.buf_dir

ports.name: host_req_i.amoop
ports.functionality: Is part of the host_req_i aggregate and is forwarded into bus_req_o by the aggregate copy; not otherwise inspected in this source.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i (aggregate copy) in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: host_req_i.lock
ports.functionality: Is part of the host_req_i aggregate copied into bus_req_o by default; the design later sets bus_req_o.lock explicitly for download sequences, overriding the copied field.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default; bus_req_o.lock overwritten in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ

ports.name: host_req_i.fence
ports.functionality: Sets buffered sync requests and forces CLEAR state from IDLE when asserted. It is used both to update ctrl_nxt.buf_sync and to branch into S_CLEAR.
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence; S_IDLE checks host_req_i.fence

ports.name: host_rsp_o
ports.functionality: Reports responses back to the host by deriving its fields from either cache read data or directly from the bus response aggregate; it is driven combinationally by internal signals and bus_rsp_i.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; default host_rsp_o.data <= cache_i.data in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: host_rsp_o.ack
ports.functionality: Combinationally driven to acknowledge host requests: default low, set high when cache hit-read or when bus response indicates completion or error paths, then exported to host.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; host_rsp_o.ack <= '1' on cache hit read path and in S_DOWNLOAD_DONE error path

ports.name: host_rsp_o.err
ports.functionality: Signals error status to host. It is driven from bus responses in direct-response paths and set when buffered download reports an error, then exported.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; host_rsp_o.err <= '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_DONE when ctrl.buf_err = '1'

ports.name: host_rsp_o.data
ports.functionality: Carries read data to the host; driven from the memory read output (cache_i.data) by default and overwritten by bus_rsp_i in direct-response state, then exported.
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o.data <= cache_i.data default; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP

ports.name: bus_req_o
ports.functionality: Forwards host_req_i by default and is altered by the controller for direct accesses and downloads. It exports requests to the external bus interface.
role: derived from host_req_i and ctrl fields
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default; bus_req_o.addr/rw/lock set in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ/S_DOWNLOAD_RSP

ports.name: bus_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Carries the 32-bit address presented to the external bus. It is copied from host_req_i by default and composed from ctrl.tag/idx/ofs during downloads.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default; bus_req_o.addr <= ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs & "00" in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ

ports.name: bus_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Outputs write data on the external bus; by default copied from host_req_i.data and used when the controller issues write requests.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i (aggregate copy) in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.ben
ports.functionality: Carries byte-enable bits to the external bus; forwarded from host_req_i by default and used to control memory writes when bus transactions are issued.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.stb
ports.functionality: Indicates valid bus requests; default cleared and asserted by controller in lookup/direct/download states to start external transactions.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i then bus_req_o.stb <= '0' default; bus_req_o.stb <= '1' set in branches

ports.name: bus_req_o.rw
ports.functionality: Indicates read/write on outgoing bus requests; default copied from host_req_i, but downloads set rw <= '0' to request reads from memory.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default; bus_req_o.rw <= '0' in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ

ports.name: bus_req_o.src
ports.functionality: Field forwarded from host_req_i by aggregate copy so the bus request retains host source information; not otherwise modified in this source.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.priv
ports.functionality: Forwarded from host_req_i via the aggregate copy to the external bus; the controller does not otherwise modify it here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.debug
ports.functionality: Is forwarded from host_req_i by default so debug requests propagate to the bus; controller logic uses host_req_i.debug to select direct path earlier.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.amo
ports.functionality: Atomic operation indicator forwarded from host_req_i into the bus request aggregate by default; not otherwise modified in this source.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.amoop
ports.functionality: Forwarded from host_req_i by aggregate copy so atomic opcode reaches the bus request; not otherwise used here.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default in ctrl_engine_comb

ports.name: bus_req_o.lock
ports.functionality: Indicates locked bus transfers; initially copied from host_req_i but explicitly asserted by the controller during download request/response sequences.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o <= host_req_i default; bus_req_o.lock <= '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ

ports.name: bus_req_o.fence
ports.functionality: Used to issue fence requests on the bus when clearing cache; default cleared and asserted in S_CLEAR when READ_ONLY is false.
ports.evidence: bus_req_o.fence <= '1' in S_CLEAR when READ_ONLY = false; default bus_req_o.fence <= '0'

ports.name: bus_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Supplies responses from the external bus to the controller; its ack/err/data fields drive host responses, buffer error state, and supply download data to cache_o.data.
role: sources cache download data and errors
ports.evidence: host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP; cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; if (bus_rsp_i.ack = '1') then ...

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Indicates completion of external bus transfer and is used to advance the state machine from direct-response or download responses to subsequent states.
ports.evidence: if (bus_rsp_i.ack = '1') then ctrl_nxt.state <= S_IDLE in S_DIRECT_RSP and S_DOWNLOAD_RSP

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.err
ports.functionality: Delivers error indication from the external bus; the controller accumulates it into ctrl.buf_err to affect download completion behavior and host responses.
ports.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP

ports.name: bus_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: Provides read data from the bus which is written into cache_o.data during downloads and also forwarded to the host in direct-response state.
ports.evidence: cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; host_rsp_o <= bus_rsp_i in S_DIRECT_RSP

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Active-low asynchronous reset that overrides and clears stored state in status memory. It forces valid_mem and valid_mem_rd to defined reset values in the status_memory process.
ports.evidence: status_memory process: if (rstn_i = '0') then valid_mem <= (others => '0'); valid_mem_rd <= '0'.

ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Global rising-edge clock that sequences updates to status, tag and data memories. It times writes/reads in status_memory, tag_memory and data_memory processes.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) is used in status_memory, tag_memory and data_memory processes to update registers.

ports.name: clr_i
ports.functionality: Synchronous clear request that, when '1' on a clock edge, writes zeros to the entire valid_mem vector. It therefore invalidates all cache lines.
role: gates storage update for valid bits
ports.evidence: status_memory process: elsif rising_edge(clk_i) then if (clr_i = '1') then valid_mem <= (others => '0');

ports.name: inv_i
ports.functionality: Synchronous invalidate signal that clears the valid bit for the indexed cache line (acc_idx) when asserted at a clock edge. It targets a single valid_mem entry.
ports.evidence: status_memory process: elsif (inv_i = '1') then valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= '0';

ports.name: new_i
ports.functionality: Synchronous signal that, when '1' at a clock edge, sets the valid bit for acc_idx and writes acc_tag into tag_mem at that index. It enables allocation of a new cache line.
role: sets valid bit and writes tag
ports.evidence: status_memory and tag_memory processes: if (new_i = '1') then valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= '1'; tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= acc_tag;

ports.name: hit_o
ports.functionality: Combinational output that reports a hit when the registered valid bit (valid_mem_rd) is '1' and the registered tag (tag_mem_rd) matches acc_tag. It exposes hit status to the outside.
ports.evidence: Concurrent assignment: hit_o <= '1' when (valid_mem_rd = '1') and (tag_mem_rd = acc_tag) else '0';

ports.name: addr_i
ports.functionality: Supplies the 32-bit address bits that are sliced into tag (acc_tag), index (acc_idx) and offset (acc_off). These derived signals drive memory indexing and tag comparisons.
ports.evidence: Concurrent assignments: acc_tag <= addr_i(31 downto ...); acc_idx <= addr_i(...); acc_off <= addr_i(...).

ports.name: we_i
ports.functionality: 4-bit input vector where each bit gates the synchronous write of the corresponding data_mem_bX array byte when asserted. Controls which bytes of a word are written.
ports.evidence: data_memory process: if (we_i(0) = '1') then data_mem_b0(...) <= wdata_i(7 downto 0); (and similarly for we_i(1..3)).

ports.name: wdata_i
ports.functionality: 32-bit write data source split into four bytes that feed the four byte-wide data memories. When the corresponding we_i bit is set, each byte is captured into the respective data_mem_bX at acc_adr.
ports.evidence: data_memory process: data_mem_b0(...) <= wdata_i(7 downto 0); data_mem_b1(...) <= wdata_i(15 downto 8); etc.

ports.name: rdata_o
ports.functionality: 32-bit output that is assembled at each clock edge from the four byte memories indexed by acc_adr. Each rdata_o byte slice equals the corresponding data_mem_bX read value.
ports.evidence: data_memory process: rdata_o(7 downto 0) <= data_mem_b0(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))); (and similarly for other byte slices).

signals.name: cache_o
signals.functionality: Aggregate of commands, address, data and write enables produced by controller logic and forwarded to the cache memory instance via port map. Fields are set combinationally.
signals.evidence: cache_o fields assigned in ctrl_engine_comb and port map connecting cache_o.* to memory instance

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_clr
signals.functionality: Issued combinationally to request cache clear; set in S_CLEAR and forwarded to memory instance CLR input.
signals.evidence: cache_o.cmd_clr <= '1' in S_CLEAR and port map clr_i => cache_o.cmd_clr

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_inv
signals.functionality: Issued combinationally to invalidate a cache line when a download produced an error; forwarded to the memory instance INV input.
signals.evidence: cache_o.cmd_inv <= '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_DONE when ctrl.buf_err = '1'; port map inv_i => cache_o.cmd_inv

signals.name: cache_o.cmd_new
signals.functionality: Asserted combinationally to request loading a new line into the cache during download sequences; forwarded to memory instance NEW input.
signals.evidence: cache_o.cmd_new <= '1' in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ; port map new_i => cache_o.cmd_new

signals.name: cache_o.addr
signals.functionality: Provides the 32-bit address presented to the cache memory. Defaulted from host_req_i.addr and replaced during downloads by concatenation of ctrl.tag/idx/ofs.
signals.evidence: cache_o.addr <= host_req_i.addr default; cache_o.addr <= ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs & "00" in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ; port map addr_i => cache_o.addr

signals.name: cache_o.data
signals.functionality: Carries write data to the cache memory; defaulted from host_req_i.data and during downloads takes bus_rsp_i.data, then forwarded to memory wdata input.
signals.evidence: cache_o.data <= host_req_i.data default; cache_o.data <= bus_rsp_i.data in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; port map wdata_i => cache_o.data

signals.name: cache_o.we
signals.functionality: Byte-wise write-enable vector for the cache memory; default zero, set from host_req_i.ben on write hits or set to all ones during download writes, forwarded to memory we input.
role: driven by write and download paths
signals.evidence: cache_o.we <= (others => '0') default; cache_o.we <= host_req_i.ben in S_LOOKUP write path; cache_o.we <= (others=>'1') in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; port map we_i => cache_o.we

signals.name: cache_i
signals.functionality: Aggregate receiving status and read-data from the memory instance. Its fields feed the controller combinationally for hit detection and host responses.
signals.evidence: port map hit_o => cache_i.sta_hit and rdata_o => cache_i.data

signals.name: cache_i.sta_hit
signals.functionality: Reflects the memory's hit output and gates controller behavior; used to select between direct responses, writes, and download paths in the lookup state.
signals.evidence: case S_LOOKUP branches on cache_i.sta_hit; port map hit_o => cache_i.sta_hit

signals.name: cache_i.data
signals.functionality: Carries read data produced by the memory instance into the controller and to host_rsp_o by default; it is sourced from the memory rdata output.
signals.evidence: host_rsp_o.data <= cache_i.data in ctrl_engine_comb; port map rdata_o => cache_i.data

signals.name: ctrl
signals.functionality: Holds the current control state and buffered flags across clock edges; capture ctrl_nxt on rising clock or reset to defaults on rstn_i '0'.
signals.evidence: ctrl <= ctrl_nxt on rising_edge(clk_i) and reset branch sets ctrl fields in ctrl_engine_sync; ctrl.state used as case selector in ctrl_engine_comb

signals.name: ctrl.state
signals.functionality: Encodes the FSM's active state and is used as the case selector driving next-state and output decisions in the combinational control process.
signals.evidence: case ctrl.state is ... in ctrl_engine_comb

signals.name: ctrl.buf_req
signals.functionality: Records that a host request is pending across cycles; it is set from host_req_i.stb combinationally and retained until cleared by the controller.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb; ctrl <= ctrl_nxt at rising_edge

signals.name: ctrl.buf_sync
signals.functionality: Holds a pending fence request across cycles; set from host_req_i.fence and cleared when S_CLEAR runs, gating a transition to CLEAR state.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence; ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= '0' in S_CLEAR; ctrl <= ctrl_nxt clocked

signals.name: ctrl.buf_err
signals.functionality: Accumulates bus error status during multi-beat downloads; updated combinationally from prior buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err and sampled into ctrl on clock edges.
role: affects download completion and host response
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; ctrl <= ctrl_nxt in ctrl_engine_sync

signals.name: ctrl.buf_dir
signals.functionality: Indicates that a request should bypass the cache (direct) when set from IDLE conditions; it is set combinationally and sampled into ctrl for use in lookup branching.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_dir <= '1' in S_IDLE when UC_BEGIN/amo/debug conditions; ctrl <= ctrl_nxt at clock

signals.name: ctrl.tag
signals.functionality: Holds the tag bits of the currently processed address; set in lookup from host_req_i.addr and used to form bus/cache addresses during downloads.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.tag <= host_req_i.addr(...) in S_LOOKUP; cache_o.addr <= ctrl.tag & ctrl.idx & ctrl.ofs & "00" in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ

signals.name: ctrl.idx
signals.functionality: Holds the index bits extracted from address during lookup; used with tag/ofs to form full addresses for cache fills and bus transactions.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.idx <= host_req_i.addr(...) in S_LOOKUP; concatenated into addresses in S_DOWNLOAD_REQ

signals.name: ctrl.ofs
signals.functionality: Tracks the current word offset within a cache line during multi-beat downloads; incremented when a bus beat is acknowledged and used to detect download completion via and_reduce_f.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.ofs <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(ctrl.ofs) + 1) in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP; and_reduce_f(ctrl.ofs) used to detect completion

signals.name: ctrl_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinational next-state and output driver for the FSM: computed from current ctrl, host_req_i, cache_i and bus_rsp_i and then sampled into ctrl on clock edges.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt assigned throughout ctrl_engine_comb and ctrl <= ctrl_nxt at rising_edge(clk_i)

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.state
signals.functionality: Holds the combinationally computed next FSM state based on ctrl, host_req_i, cache_i and bus_rsp_i; it is sampled into ctrl.state on clock edges.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.state <= ... assigned in each case branch of ctrl_engine_comb; ctrl <= ctrl_nxt in ctrl_engine_sync

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_req
signals.functionality: Combinationally computes updated buffered request by OR-ing prior buffer and host_req_i.stb; then sampled into ctrl.buf_req on clock edge.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_req <= ctrl.buf_req or host_req_i.stb at top of ctrl_engine_comb

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync
signals.functionality: Combinationally computes buffered fence/sync as OR of prior buffer and host fence; cleared in S_CLEAR branch; sampled into ctrl.buf_sync on clock edge.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= ctrl.buf_sync or host_req_i.fence and ctrl_nxt.buf_sync <= '0' in S_CLEAR

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_err
signals.functionality: Combinationally accumulates bus errors (OR) with prior buf_err during download responses and is sampled into ctrl.buf_err at the clock edge.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_err <= ctrl.buf_err or bus_rsp_i.err in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.buf_dir
signals.functionality: Computed combinationally in IDLE if host request requires direct access (UC_BEGIN/amo/debug) and sampled into ctrl.buf_dir on the next clock edge; otherwise cleared by default.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.buf_dir set in S_IDLE when addr >= UC_BEGIN or amo/debug; ctrl <= ctrl_nxt at rising_edge

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.tag
signals.functionality: Combinationally takes tag slice from host_req_i.addr during lookup and is sampled into ctrl.tag on the next clock edge to identify the requested line.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.tag <= host_req_i.addr(31 downto 32-tag_size_c) in S_LOOKUP

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.idx
signals.functionality: Combinationally extracts index bits from host_req_i.addr in lookup and is captured into ctrl.idx at the next clock edge to select cache set.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.idx <= host_req_i.addr(...) in S_LOOKUP

signals.name: ctrl_nxt.ofs
signals.functionality: Combinationally set to zero on lookup and incremented during download responses; sampled into ctrl.ofs on clock to progress multi-beat downloads.
signals.evidence: ctrl_nxt.ofs <= (others=>'0') in S_LOOKUP; ctrl_nxt.ofs <= std_ulogic_vector(unsigned(ctrl.ofs)+1) in S_DOWNLOAD_RSP

signals.name: valid_mem
signals.functionality: Vector storing the valid bit for each cache block; synchronous updates occur on reset, clr, inv and new using acc_idx. It is read combinationally to produce valid_mem_rd.
signals.evidence: status_memory process: valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= '0'/'1' on inv/new/clr; valid_mem_rd <= valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))).

signals.name: valid_mem_rd
signals.functionality: Single-bit register that captures the selected bit of valid_mem at each clock edge (using acc_idx) and supplies the registered valid state to hit logic (hit_o).
signals.evidence: status_memory process (rising_edge): valid_mem_rd <= valid_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))); hit_o uses valid_mem_rd in its when expression.

signals.name: tag_mem
signals.functionality: Array of tag vectors, one per block, written synchronously with acc_tag when new_i is asserted and read into tag_mem_rd each clock. Stores tags used for hit comparisons.
signals.evidence: tag_memory process: if rising_edge(clk_i) then if (new_i = '1') then tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))) <= acc_tag; tag_mem_rd <= tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx)));

signals.name: tag_mem_rd
signals.functionality: Register that captures the tag_mem entry selected by acc_idx each clock and supplies the registered tag to the hit comparison with acc_tag.
signals.evidence: tag_memory process: tag_mem_rd <= tag_mem(to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx))); hit_o compares tag_mem_rd to acc_tag.

signals.name: data_mem_b0
signals.functionality: Byte-wide memory array storing the least-significant byte of words. When we_i(0) is '1' on a clock edge it captures wdata_i(7 downto 0) at acc_adr; its read value is forwarded to rdata_o(7 downto 0).
signals.evidence: data_memory process: if (we_i(0) = '1') then data_mem_b0(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(7 downto 0); rdata_o(7 downto 0) <= data_mem_b0(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr)));

signals.name: data_mem_b1
signals.functionality: Byte-wide memory array storing the next byte of words. Captures wdata_i(15 downto 8) when we_i(1) is asserted and supplies rdata_o(15 downto 8) from the indexed location.
signals.evidence: data_memory process: if (we_i(1) = '1') then data_mem_b1(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(15 downto 8); rdata_o(15 downto 8) <= data_mem_b1(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr)));

signals.name: data_mem_b2
signals.functionality: Byte-wide memory array storing the next byte of words. Captures wdata_i(23 downto 16) under we_i(2) and supplies rdata_o(23 downto 16) from the indexed location.
signals.evidence: data_memory process: if (we_i(2) = '1') then data_mem_b2(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(23 downto 16); rdata_o(23 downto 16) <= data_mem_b2(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr)));

signals.name: data_mem_b3
signals.functionality: Byte-wide memory array storing the most-significant byte of words. Captures wdata_i(31 downto 24) when we_i(3) is asserted and supplies rdata_o(31 downto 24) from the indexed location.
signals.evidence: data_memory process: if (we_i(3) = '1') then data_mem_b3(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr))) <= wdata_i(31 downto 24); rdata_o(31 downto 24) <= data_mem_b3(to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr)));

signals.name: acc_tag
signals.functionality: Combinational slice of addr_i that extracts the tag field. It feeds tag_mem writes (on new_i) and the hit comparison with tag_mem_rd.
signals.evidence: Concurrent assignment acc_tag <= addr_i(31 downto 31-(tag_size_c-1)); tag_memory and hit_o use acc_tag.

signals.name: acc_idx
signals.functionality: Combinational slice of addr_i that extracts the index field. It selects which valid and tag entries to access and forms the high part of the data address (acc_adr).
signals.evidence: acc_idx <= addr_i(31-tag_size_c downto 2+offset_size_c); used as to_integer(unsigned(acc_idx)) to index valid_mem/tag_mem and concatenated into acc_adr.

signals.name: acc_off
signals.functionality: Combinational slice of addr_i that extracts the block offset bits. It forms the low part of acc_adr and thus participates in indexing the byte memories.
signals.evidence: acc_off <= addr_i(2+(offset_size_c-1) downto 2); acc_adr <= acc_idx & acc_off.

signals.name: acc_adr
signals.functionality: Combinational concatenation of acc_idx and acc_off used as the address into the byte memories. acc_adr is converted to integer and selects entries in data_mem_b0..b3 for reads and writes.
signals.evidence: acc_adr <= acc_idx & acc_off; data_memory process uses to_integer(unsigned(acc_adr)) to index data_mem_b0..b3 for reads/writes.
